ship.todo: Shiplist weapon and arc codes are still unknown. Header detection for shiplist.txt is pending the issue #6 inventory. Until then the only ship-section keys are the synthetic TEST-* codes below. Do not add observed shiplist strings here.

TEST-FA.note: Synthetic forward wedge equal to shield facing 0: [60075, 65536) U [0, 5462).

fighter.source: Metadata-only Community Edition 2.670 ftrlist inventory (issue #6, baseline issue #37). Names of codes only. No row counts.

Ph2.note: Family reading is pending playtest. Charge cost, range bands and damage are data rows and are intentionally empty.

Ph3.reading: Phaser of the third family, the shorter-ranged of the common phaser pair.
Ph3.note: Range and damage stay empty until playtest.

PhG.reading: Rapid-fire phaser. The G suffix is not given a tighter meaning here.
PhG.note: Ambiguous: G may mean a gatling mount or another phaser variant.

PhoF.reading: Photon torpedo on a fighter mount. Uses the photon arming, overload and proximity mechanisms once its cost row is filled.
PhoF.note: Ambiguous: the trailing F is read as fighter-scale. It might instead mark a fast or otherwise special warhead.

DisF.note: Ambiguous trailing F, same caution as PhoF. Outside the Phase 2 duel fire path.

HellF.note: Ambiguous trailing F. Outside the Phase 2 duel fire path.

FusF.reading: Fusion beam on a fighter mount.
FusF.note: Ambiguous trailing F. Outside the Phase 2 duel fire path.

DroI.reading: Drone whose suffix reads as mark I.
DroI.note: Ambiguous: the roman suffix may be a mark, a speed class or a warhead. On ftrlist the arc is its own column, so this code does not reuse the shiplist trick of storing reloads in the arc cell.

DroVI.reading: Drone whose suffix reads as mark VI.

ALL.reading: Every relative bearing. The letters say the whole circle; confirm the code is not a near-circle with a blind spot.

FH.reading: Narrow forward arc. Working geometry uses shield facing 0 only, so a target in FH is in the front shield bin.
FH.note: Pending verification. The H may mean a one-facing wedge or a different forward width.

FX.reading: Extended forward arc. Working geometry is the forward half-circle: facings 5, 0 and 1.
FX.note: Pending verification. Extended may be wider than a hemisphere.

RA.reading: Rear arc. Working geometry is shield facing 3 only.
RA.note: Pending verification. Rear may be wider than one facing.

RX.reading: Extended rear arc. Working geometry is the rear half-circle: facings 2, 3 and 4.
RX.note: Pending verification. Same width caution as FX.

LS.reading: Port (left) side arc, centred on relative bearing 49152. Working geometry is facings 4 and 5.
LS.note: Pending verification. Side arcs may be one facing, two facings, or a full half-circle.

RS.reading: Starboard (right) side arc, centred on relative bearing 16384. Working geometry is facings 1 and 2.
RS.note: Pending verification. Same width caution as LS.
